# Generated by gen_theme_admin.py from 《军区详细设计》; edit the generator tables and regenerate instead of editing by hand.

# Theme scope. The course can change: one of the author's four convertible types (so not the Latin exarchate or
# the Italian chartered city), a seat on Byzantine land, no 5-year cooldown.
oe_ta_can_change_course = {
    oe_theme_convertible_trigger = yes
    capital = { owner = c:BYZ }
    NOT = { oe_ts_charter = yes }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_focus_cd }
}
oe_ta_course_ok_army = { NOT = { oe_ts_course_army = yes } }
oe_ta_course_ok_navy = { NOT = { oe_ts_course_navy = yes } capital = { is_coastal = yes } }
# A frontier march cannot turn civil: it lives under arms.
oe_ta_course_ok_civil = { NOT = { oe_ts_course_civil = yes } NOT = { oe_ts_frontier = yes } }
# r9: the theme has at least one course it may take (else the course button stays off).
oe_ta_any_course_ok = { OR = { oe_ta_course_ok_army = yes oe_ta_course_ok_navy = yes oe_ta_course_ok_civil = yes } }
# Pronoia grants: oe_ti_pronoia_allowed (BYZ scope, gen_territory_inner.py) reads the vanilla pronoia policies.
# Theme scope. AI Byzantium's course for a heartland or march theme (plan section 9): a march under arms,
# a coastal heartland seat at sea while naval themes are under a third of all themes, an inland heartland seat civil.
oe_ta_ai_course_army = { oe_ts_frontier = yes NOT = { oe_ts_course_army = yes } }
oe_ta_ai_course_navy = {
    oe_ts_core = yes capital = { is_coastal = yes } NOT = { oe_ts_course_navy = yes }
    c:BYZ = { oe_ta_navy_count < oe_ta_navy_cap }
}
oe_ta_ai_course_civil = { oe_ts_core = yes capital = { is_coastal = no } NOT = { oe_ts_course_civil = yes } }
oe_ta_ai_wants_change = {
    oe_ta_can_change_course = yes
    has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty_band var:oe_theme_loyalty_band >= 2
    OR = { oe_ta_ai_course_army = yes oe_ta_ai_course_navy = yes oe_ta_ai_course_civil = yes }
}
